Inputs.Context:
question:Will the median home value in New York City be between $560,000 and $570,000 by February 1?
option_name(期权正反买）:Yes
Price_Buy_ask:0.16
Price_Now_ask:0.22
endDate:2026-02-11T04:59:00Z
NowTime:2026-01-19T04:59:00Z
rules:This market will resolve according to the median home value for all property types in New York City, New York on February 1, 2026.
If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.
The resolution source will be official data from the Parcl Labs Sales Price Index for New York City (Parcl_ID: 5372594). The settlement price will be calculated by multiplying the published price index value (price per square foot) by 1000 square feet, which is the median home size in New York City. Parcl is set to publish this data on February 1, 2026. If no data for February 1 is released by February 10, 2026, 11:59PM ET, this market will resolve according to the most recently published data. (see: https://app.parcllabs.com/prediction-market-resolutions/1)
Max_Buy:20
Max_Sell:20
depth_ask_1c_usd：3600
depth_bid_1c_usd：400
Inputs.name: CFT

Inputs.Context:
纽约市（New York, NY/NYC）“房价中位数”会因口径不同而不一样。下面给你最常用的 3 个口径（最新页面数据截至 2025 年 11–12 月）：

Redfin：成交价中位数（Median Sale Price）：$875,000（2025 年 12 月）

Zillow：成交价中位数（Median Sale Price）：$748,333（2025 年 11 月）

Zillow：典型房屋价值（ZHVI / “Typical Home Value”，常被当作“房价中位数”的替代）：$797,328（页面显示的当前值；ZHVI 的定义是 35–65 分位区间的“典型值”）
